summary: Senior Observability, APM, and Data Engineering professional with 20+ years of enterprise IT experience across monitoring platforms, performance engineering, telemetry analytics, capacity planning, and automation. Strong fit for enterprise observability roles requiring Dynatrace/AppMon, synthetic monitoring, transaction tracing, dashboards, alerting, Python scripting, Linux/Unix, documentation, performance analysis, and stakeholder reporting. Experienced turning large-scale infrastructure and application telemetry into actionable KPIs, forecasts, runbooks, and executive-ready insights in regulated enterprise environments.

experience.title: Senior Capacity & Data Engineer
bullets: Built automated Python/Pandas telemetry pipelines ingesting P95 performance and capacity data from 6,000+ infrastructure endpoints, replacing manual reporting with repeatable, validated workflows.

Managed and integrated enterprise monitoring feeds from BMC TrueSight/TSCO, CA Wily/APM, and AppDynamics into unified reporting datasets for capacity planning, performance analysis, and executive risk visibility.
Developed dashboards and operational reports using Streamlit, matplotlib, seaborn, and plotly to surface infrastructure KPIs, trends, bottlenecks, and capacity risks for senior stakeholders.
Applied performance and capacity analysis across CPU, memory, utilization, and infrastructure telemetry to identify underutilized assets, forecast demand, and support cost-aware optimization.
Designed data quality, reconciliation, and validation checks for telemetry pipelines to improve trust in monitoring reports, forecasts, and operational decision-making.
Created ML forecasting models with Prophet and scikit-learn to predict capacity bottlenecks months ahead and support proactive remediation planning.
Supported operational excellence through troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, documentation, stakeholder communication, and repeatable runbook-style practices.
Worked in a regulated banking environment with audit, access, compliance, and data-governance expectations for infrastructure and application reporting.

experience.title: Performance Engineer
bullets: Managed Dynatrace AppMon and Gomez Synthetic Monitoring for Brand.com and critical hospitality systems, supporting production observability across web and mobile platforms.
Implemented End-User Monitoring and end-to-end transaction tracing to improve visibility into user experience, response times, and application performance behavior.
Led the FAST project, mining real-user and synthetic performance metrics to identify optimization opportunities and deliver actionable recommendations to engineering teams.
Integrated HP Performance Center with Dynatrace to correlate load-test behavior with APM telemetry and support performance-driven release decisions.
Upgraded Dynatrace AppMon from 6.5 to 7.0 and enforced TLS 1.2 security without regression in production monitoring coverage.
Produced performance reports, dashboards, and technical findings for engineering and business stakeholders.

experience.title: SME for CA APM (Senior Consultant)
bullets: Served as CA APM subject matter expert for a large enterprise environment with 50+ Enterprise Managers and 4,000–6,000 instrumented agents.
Designed and maintained dashboards, alerts, SLA thresholds, management modules, and performance reporting standards used across client monitoring environments.
Built Perl and Korn Shell data-extraction scripts to automate performance reporting and reduce manual weekly export work.
Provided sizing recommendations, agent onboarding guidance, and Golden Image deployment patterns to improve monitoring consistency and reduce setup time.
Collaborated with J2EE/WebLogic performance teams to troubleshoot bottlenecks using APM telemetry, SQL/Oracle data, thread behavior, and infrastructure signals.
Delivered client training, technical documentation, and operational guidance for monitoring standards, agent deployments, and production troubleshooting.

experience.title: APM Consultant
bullets: Supported enterprise CA APM, CA CEM, and CA ADA monitoring solutions for utility systems.
Assisted with monitoring support, troubleshooting, and operational visibility across application-performance environments.

experience.title: Performance Test Engineer
bullets: Analyzed J2EE telecom web applications under load to identify throughput limits and bottlenecks across JDBC connections, threads, heap memory, CPU, and garbage collection behavior.
Installed and configured JMX Monitoring, Wily Introscope, and thread-dump automation scripts to improve visibility during performance tests.
Documented performance baselines and regression thresholds used by engineering teams for release gate decisions.

experience.title: Senior Systems & Data Migration Engineer
bullets: Led migration of a high-throughput shopping engine from 200+ MySQL nodes to a 6-node Oracle RAC cluster while preserving strict transaction performance and reliability expectations.
Optimized core transaction processing using C++, OCCI, OCI, SQL, and Oracle, reducing physical hardware footprint while maintaining sub-second query latency.
Built validation tooling to verify data correctness and performance behavior across large transaction datasets during phased migration.
